data.raw_text:
🚨 More than 1.4 million people are displaced in the aftermath of Typhoon Fung-wong. 🚨

Over the weekend, the super typhoon made landfall in the northern Philippines, bringing powerful winds, flooding, and landslides.

This disaster comes just days after another destructive storm, Typhoon Kalmaegi, lashed the central Philippines and Vietnam.

People in the Philippines have faced one disaster after another — from powerful typhoons to devastating earthquakes. Communities are being pushed to their limits, and thousands of families are in desperate need of food, water, and shelter.

When disasters strike — one after another — Convoy of Hope is there. And because of generous supporters like you, we can bring hope to families who desperately need it.

Learn more: https://t.co/zrAMRwFcoB

(Photo by @AP)

#typhoonfungwong #typhoonkalmaegi #philippines #disasterresponse
